---
title: "Tutorial path"
description: "Nine executable lessons, from the JL illusion to choosing m."
---

The lessons form a narrative, but each can stand alone. Every page has a
matching executable notebook under `notebooks/tutorials/`.

| # | Lesson | What you will be able to do |
|---:|---|---|
| 00 | [The JL illusion](00-jl-illusion.qmd) | Separate baseline preservation from fluctuation preservation |
| 01 | [Beta–gamma and Laguerre](01-beta-gamma.qmd) | Read the exact scalar channel and its spectrum |
| 02 | [Arcsine and Kendall](02-arcsine-kendall.qmd) | Compute pairwise and ranking survival |
| 03 | [Nearest neighbor and plurality](03-nearest-neighbor.qmd) | Interpret fixed-candidate argmin stability |
| 04 | [Anisotropy](04-anisotropy.qmd) | Diagnose nonlinear excess and balanced retention |
| 05 | [Covariance shape](05-shape.qmd) | Compare mean, scale, and shape contraction |
| 06 | [General maps and ensembles](06-maps-ensembles.qmd) | Separate rank, spectrum, and precision |
| 07 | [Audit real features](07-realdata-audit.qmd) | Compare a matrix with the Gaussian budget |
| 08 | [Choose m](08-choose-m.qmd) | Turn a fine-geometry requirement into a dimension |

```bash
jupyter lab notebooks/tutorials
```

Each notebook is CI-executed from a clean kernel, uses a fixed seed where
needed, and ends with an interpretation rather than only a plot.
